capabilities: Draw print-style Go diagrams from code blocks, SGF files or embedded links
Play and edit boards interactively with captures, variations, marks and a move tree panel
Build interactive problems with correct/incorrect lines, hints and shuffling
Import games and problems from OGS, goproblems.com, Josekipedia and Sensei's Library
Show boards from links to Go sites and render SGF files as Bases cards
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later. Goes online only to fetch games, problems or SGF files you embed or import; an optional goproblems.com token is kept in Obsidian's secret storage. Games on Tygem, WBaduk and PlayGo and problems on sites requiring sign-in cannot be shown. Includes extensive notes on how board edits are matched to code blocks and how failures are handled.
problem: Obsidian has no way to draw, play or judge Go game records and problems; SGF files have nowhere to live or be shown in notes.

summary: Code-block renderer that draws print-style Go (baduk) boards — positions, numbered figures and clickable problems — stored as SGF.
